hypothesis.root_cause: do_attr obtains a Python attribute directly and only checks the resulting object, bypassing the sandbox environment lookup that applies special handling to string formatting methods.
hypothesis.expected_violation: the sandboxed attr filter returns a callable string formatter that reveals an owned object type
